decisions.reason: Its shift from a simple mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests performance at or above aspiration in the firm’s core footwear business, so management would likely retain it.

Its unchanged, low-prominence website position suggests only modest results, but as a complementary insole with limited resource demands in a large firm with slack, it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.

The product appears to have stayed below standout aspiration levels, yet because it supports the core shoe offering and does not seem costly to carry, management would probably continue it while monitoring demand.
A dedicated page in both years indicates sustained strategic attention and acceptable results for this ergonomic safety-shoe line, making continuation very likely.
Its move from a mention to a dedicated page points to improving acceptance in a specialized niche, and the firm’s quality-focused industrial positioning supports keeping it on the market.
As a homepage-featured flagship with visible customer-use evidence tied to foot measurement and individualized insoles, it appears clearly above aspiration and central to the firm’s direction.
